findings.summary: Dependency-hold summaries preserve ordinary failure runs
findings.evidence: src/logger.ts:195-205 now returns without recording a hold unless a blocker is AWAITING-ADJUDICATION. src/logger.test.ts:206-220 and src/orchestrator-runs.test.ts:1129-1132 assert that ordinary STUCK runs do not gain a Dependency Holds section. The authorized full test gate passed on tree ddbce6d20cc6b5b4efc59d26646c3e9f45fbf41a.
findings.expected: The summary records the new dependency-hold projection only when an unresolved blocker is AWAITING-ADJUDICATION, while ordinary failure summaries remain unchanged.
findings.observed: The logger filters holds to AWAITING-ADJUDICATION blockers, and unit plus existing spawned-scenario assertions preserve ordinary failure summary output.
findings.clearCondition: The summary records the new dependency-hold projection only when an unresolved blocker is AWAITING-ADJUDICATION, with a regression assertion that ordinary failure summaries remain unchanged.

findings.summary: The new spawned wave lacks the required cost-justification comment
findings.evidence: src/wave.test.ts:153 adds a new spawned wave scenario that measured 6474ms in the authorized test log, but the test has no comment explaining why an existing spawned scenario cannot reach the required state.
findings.expected: AGENTS.md requires every genuinely necessary new spawned scenario to include a comment explaining why its distinct fixture state cannot be covered more cheaply.
findings.observed: The impasse wave scenario is behaviorally meaningful and passes, but its required cost rationale is implicit rather than recorded.
findings.clearCondition: Add a concise comment beside the scenario explaining why the contract-impasse-before-lane-partition state requires this separate spawned wave, or consolidate it into an existing spawned fixture without losing coverage.
